description: One UI 9, Samsung's latest software update, introduces new features such as agentic AI capabilities, enhanced security, and productivity tools.

sections.heading: Overview of One UI 9
paragraphs: One UI 9, Samsung's latest software update, is set to debut with a range of new features and improvements. According to News18, the update includes agentic AI capabilities, stronger security, and new productivity tools.

sections.heading: New Features
paragraphs: Sammy Fans reports that the Galaxy S25 One UI 9 update will bring features such as Now Nudge, Horizon Lock camera, and My FanCam. These additions are expected to enhance the user experience by providing more personalized and interactive functionalities.

sections.heading: Security and Productivity
paragraphs: News18 highlights that One UI 9 focuses on stronger security measures and introduces new productivity tools. These enhancements are aimed at providing users with a safer and more efficient user experience.

sections.heading: Rollout for Other Devices
paragraphs: Gadgets 360 reports that test builds for One UI 9 have been spotted for the Samsung Galaxy A55 and Galaxy A35, indicating that the update is on its way for these devices as well.
